input: Find arts, music, theater, dance, STEM, academic and cooking summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Sylva, Dillsboro, Cullowhee, Cashiers, Cherokee and Bryson City, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Sylva Cullowhee summer camps 2026 art music STEM kids

candidates.name: Western Carolina University
candidates.note: Youth camps include art, science, robotics and theatre; 2025 machining bootcamps also accepted high-school students.

candidates.name: Southwestern Community College
candidates.note: Summer 2025 offerings included arts-and-crafts programs for middle- and high-school students.

candidates.name: Calliope Stage
candidates.note: Three 2026 youth camp offerings included teen playwriting and a June acting, singing and dancing performance camp.

candidates.name: Cashiers Historical Society
candidates.note: Co-presented July 22–24, 2026 traditional folk and old-time music camp with Blue Ridge JAM for grades 4–8.

candidates.name: Blue Ridge JAM
candidates.note: Ran a three-day July 2026 folk and old-time music camp for grades 4–8 with Cashiers Historical Society.

candidates.name: First Baptist Church of Sylva
candidates.note: First Explorers summer camp ran in 2026 with crafts, plant science, library visits and field trips.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of the Plateau
candidates.note: Free summer camps served children and teens at the Cashiers Club and Abell Teen Club in 2025 and 2026.

candidates.name: Cherokee Youth Center
candidates.note: Summer youth programming serves ages 5–18; the center provides arts-and-crafts instruction.

candidates.name: Cedar Creek Club
candidates.note: Summer Kids Camp offers eight weeks of arts and crafts, outdoor activities and nature discovery, mid-June through mid-August.
